canonical_title: Control force variations during rapid speed changes

versions.title_at_revision: Control force variations during rapid speed changes
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle flying qualities are no worse than Level 2 as it accelerates and decelerates rapidly through the operational speed range to maintain the desired LF. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the flying qualities due to pitch control variations during a rapid speed change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Force Variations during Rapid Speed Changes paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the flying/handling qualities due to pitch control variations during a rapid speed change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Force Variations during Rapid Speed Changes paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the flying/handling qualities due to pitch control variations during a rapid speed change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Force Variations during Rapid Speed Changes paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and environmental conditions.
